description: Registry of Financial-Analyst-Skills AI orchestrated processes.

skills.name: Skills Orchestrator Pipeline
skills.description: A runbook for reasoning models to execute the complete financial-analyst-skills pipeline in the correct dependency order. Routes documents through different skill chains based on document type.

skills.name: Document Classification
skills.description: Classify financial PDFs by extracting company identity, document type, and date metadata. Validates ticker via Yahoo Finance with multi-step fallback.

skills.name: Document Organization
skills.description: Move processed documents from processing_data/ to output_data/TICKER/, create/update company metadata, and perform cross-document date healing.

skills.name: Financial Calculations
skills.description: A single deterministic Python script to compute all derived financial metrics (EBITA, Invested Capital, Tax Rates, Summary Table) from extracted financial data in the correct dependency chain.

skills.name: Financial Data Extraction
skills.description: Extract balance sheet, income statement, shares outstanding, organic growth, and GAAP reconciliation data from financial PDFs. Standardize via Tiger-Transformer and append structured output to the document markdown.

skills.name: Qualitative Assessment
skills.description: Assess economic moat, EBITA margin trajectory, and organic growth trajectory from analyst reports, transcripts, or articles. Produces structured outlook that feeds into DCF assumption generation.

skills.name: Financial Modeling
skills.description: A single deterministic Python script that computes WACC (via CAPM), generates three-stage DCF assumptions from historical trends and qualitative outlook, projects 10 years of free cash flow, calculates terminal and enterprise value, and derives intrinsic value per share.

skills.name: Model JSON Generator
skills.description: Parses the generated financial modeling data from the metadata markdown and formats it into a structured JSON file for the interactive DCF viewer.
